headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a closely contested game, with Jackson Merrill leading the Padres' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras hitting a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field. The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1 in a closely contested game, with Brent Headrick earning the win for the Yankees.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Colorado Rockies placed RHP Tanner Gordon on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 2, 2026, due to right hip impingement. The San Diego Padres placed RHP Jeremiah Estrada on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 3, 2026, due to right knee inflammation. The Milwaukee Brewers placed LHP DL Hall on the 15-day injured list due to a left pectoral strain.

Several teams made notable roster moves. The Boston Red Sox acquired LHP Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Los Angeles Angels traded C Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a closely contested game. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the offense. Contreras hit a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field, contributing to the Orioles' win.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1 in a closely contested game. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 12-9 win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning 18-3 in a one-sided contest. Edward Cabrera led the Giants' pitching staff, while Casey Schmitt and Rafael Devers were among the top performers at the plate.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Mariners 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with several players making significant contributions to the game. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Kerry Carpenter, Riley Greene, and Spencer Torkelson, while Bryan Woo was a standout pitcher for the team.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Tanner Gordon Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Heads to Boston in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates traded left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa to the Boston Red Sox on June 4, 2026.
